column1: # Recipes for `cachyos-agent local`: open models Ollama can run for your agents.
# Columns, separated by one tab:
#   id             name you type, and the model name clients send to the endpoint
#   ollama_model   tag pulled from the Ollama library
#   min_vram_gib   GPU memory that holds the whole model and its context cache
#   min_ram_gib    system RAM that holds them with room left for the desktop
#   context        tokens of context the model is created with (Ollama's own
#                  default is 4K below 24 GiB of VRAM, too small for an agent)
#   note           shown by `local list`
# The thresholds are estimates, rounded up: the library's download size, plus a
# context cache sized from each model's layers and KV heads, plus 1.5 GiB of
# compute buffers on the GPU or 8 GiB of headroom in RAM. A machine under
# min_vram_gib still runs the model by spilling layers into RAM, only slower.
# `local use best` takes the first row that fits in GPU memory, else the first
# that fits in RAM, so keep the strongest model first.
# Every ollama_model was checked on https://ollama.com/library/<model>/tags on
# 2026-11-02 (tag present, tool calling listed, size as in the notes below).
# Re-check the tags before changing this file.
